title: Rapis
description: Attested on the Peutinger Map, ancient Rapis lay on a route from Augusta Vindelicum (modern Augsburg, Germany) to Navoa and thence to Cambodunum (modern Kempten). BAtlas follows Römer Bayern in tentatively placing Rapis at modern Schwabmünchen.

properties.description: 1:1 million scale representative point location digitized from the Barrington Atlas of the Greek and Roman World by the Digital Atlas of Roman and Medieval Civilizations project at Harvard University.
